verses.sloka: तस्य राक्षसराजस्य निशम्य परिदेवितम् ।कुम्भकर्णो बभाषेदं वचनं प्रजहास च ।। ६.६३.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya rākṣasarājasya niśamya paridevitam ।kumbhakarṇo babhāṣedaṁ vacanaṁ prajahāsa ca ।। 6.63.1 ।।

translations.english: Hearing the lament of the Rakshasa king, Kumbhakarna replied laughing.

verses.sloka: दृष्टो दोषो हि यो ऽस्माभिः पुरा मन्त्रविनिर्णये ।हितेष्वनभिरक्तेन सो ऽयमासादितस्त्वया ।। ६.६३.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭo doṣo hi yo 'smābhiḥ purā mantravinirṇaye ।hiteṣvanabhiraktena so 'yamāsāditastvayā ।। 6.63.2 ।।

translations.english: "While we were discussing earlier and taking decisions, that disaster foreseen by me has reaped for having not trusted the well wishers."
translations.hindi: उस समय वह पर्वताकार राक्षसश्रेष्ठ कुम्भकर्ण ऐसा दिख- लाई पड़ता था, जैछे आकाश को नापते समय पूर्वकाल में चामनावतार धारी भगवान्‌ विष्णु देख पड़े थे

verses.sloka: शीघ्रं खल्वभ्युपेतं त्वां फलं पापस्य कर्मणः ।निरयेष्वेव पतनं यथा दुष्कृतकर्मणः ।। ६.६३.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: śīghraṁ khalvabhyupetaṁ tvāṁ phalaṁ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ ।nirayeṣveva patanaṁ yathā duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ ।। 6.63.3 ।।

translations.english: "Those who do sinful deeds fall unobstructed so also the fruit of your sinful action has come upon you."
translations.hindi: सजल जलद की तरह विशाल शरीरधारी एवं सुवण के बाजूबन्द पहिने हुए कुम्भकर्ण को पुनः देख, वानरों की बड़ी सेना भाग खड़ी हुई

verses.sloka: प्रथमं वै महाराज कृत्यमेतदचिन्तितम् ।केवलं वीर्यदर्पेण नानुबन्धो विचारितः ।। ६.६३.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: prathamaṁ vai mahārāja kṛtyametadacintitam ।kevalaṁ vīryadarpeṇa nānubandho vicāritaḥ ।। 6.63.4 ।।

translations.english: "O king! All this action was not thought of at the beginning, nor the consequences of action weighed in the pride of your prowess."
translations.hindi: इच्छानुसार अपने शरीर को बढ़ाते हुए कुम्भकरो को देख ओर अपनी सेना को भागते देख, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी विस्मित हुए और बिभीषण से बोले

verses.sloka: यः पश्चात् पूर्वकार्याणि कुर्यादैश्वर्यमास्थितः ।पूर्वं चापरकार्याणि न स वेद नयानयौ ।। ६.६३.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paścāt pūrvakāryāṇi kuryādaiśvaryamāsthitaḥ ।pūrvaṁ cāparakāryāṇi na sa veda nayānayau ।। 6.63.5 ।।

translations.english: "Confident of prosperity, he who defers action earlier, he does not know what is right and wrong later on."
translations.hindi: लङ्का के भीतर पवेत के समान लंबा, मुकुट घार, पीले नेत्रं वाला ओर दामिनीयुक्त मेघ की तरह यह कोन बीर देख पड़ता हे?

verses.sloka: देशकालविहीनानि कर्माणि विपरीतवत् ।क्रियमाणानि दुष्यन्ति हवींष्यप्रयतेष्विव ।। ६.६३.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: deśakālavihīnāni karmāṇi viparītavat ।kriyamāṇāni duṣyanti havīṁṣyaprayateṣviva ।। 6.63.6 ।।

translations.english: " Actions performed without regard for time and place will be disastrous like the oblations offered into fire without consecration, gets wasted."
translations.hindi: यह अकेला ही प्रथिवी की पताका की तरह जान पड़ता है, क्योंकि इसको देख कर समस्त वानर डर कर चारों ओर भाग रहे हैं

verses.sloka: त्रयाणां पञ्चधा योगं कर्मणां यः प्रपश्यति ।सचिवैः समयं कृत्वा स सभ्ये वर्तते पथि ।। ६.६३.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: trayāṇāṁ pañcadhā yogaṁ karmaṇāṁ yaḥ prapaśyati ।sacivaiḥ samayaṁ kṛtvā sa sabhye vartate pathi ।। 6.63.7 ।।

translations.english: He who thinks with ministers and considers the five aspects of threefold duties and moves in the right path performs (Five aspects of action are the method of initiating action, material to be worked upon, time and place of action, provision against mischance and the chances of success). Threefold duties with reference to enemies are Sama, Daana, and Bedha."
translations.hindi: यह विशाल शरीरधारी कोई राक्षस है अथवा असुर, मैंने तो इस प्रकारका जोव इसके पूर्व कभी देखा ही नहीं

verses.sloka: यथागमं च यो राजा समयं विचिकीर्षति ।बुध्यते सचिवान् बुद्ध्या सुहृदश्चानुपश्यति ।। ६.६३.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: yathāgamaṁ ca yo rājā samayaṁ vicikīrṣati ।budhyate sacivān buddhyā suhṛdaścānupaśyati ।। 6.63.8 ।।

translations.english: "The king who does his duty in time in accordance with justice and thinking intelligently with his ministers, understands rightly."

verses.sloka: धर्ममर्थं च कामं च सर्वान् वा रक्षसां पते ।भजेत पुरुषः काले त्रीणि द्वन्द्वानि वा पुनः ।। ६.६३.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: dharmamarthaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca sarvān vā rakṣasāṁ pate ।bhajeta puruṣaḥ kāle trīṇi dvandvāni vā punaḥ ।। 6.63.9 ।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa king! A man should pursue his duty or worldly gain or sensual pleasures all the three combined or at least any two in time (the scriptures lay down that duty should be pursued in the morning, wealth in the afternoon and sensual pleasures at night)."

verses.sloka: त्रिषु चैतेषु यच्छ्रेष्ठं श्रुत्वा तन्नावबुध्यते ।राजा वा राजमात्रो वा व्यर्थं तस्य बहुश्रुतम् ।। ६.६३.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: triṣu caiteṣu yacchreṣṭhaṁ śrutvā tannāvabudhyate ।rājā vā rājamātro vā vyarthaṁ tasya bahuśrutam ।। 6.63.10 ।।

translations.english: " A sovereign king or a king hearing these three does not recognize the best of the three is in vain even though he heard many."
translations.hindi: हे राघव ! इसने युद्ध में कितनी ही बार हजारों देवताओं, मांसभक्ती दानवो, यचों, सुमङ्गों, गन्धवों, विद्याधरो और किन्नरों को पीस डाला है

verses.sloka: उपप्रदानं सान्त्वं वा भेदं काले च विक्रमम् ।योगं च रक्षसां श्रेष्ठ तावुभौ च नयानयौ ।। ६.६३.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: upapradānaṁ sāntvaṁ vā bhedaṁ kāle ca vikramam ।yogaṁ ca rakṣasāṁ śreṣṭha tāvubhau ca nayānayau ।। 6.63.11 ।।

translations.english: "You are the foremost of the Rakshasas! After discussing with ministers, a king either by gifting or conciliation or dissension or resorting to all of them at the appropriate time takes resort to pursue virtue, wealth, or sensual pleasures at the right time, never meets with sorrow."
translations.hindi: जब यह महाबली कुम्भकणे हाथ में शूल ले आँखें बदलता है या आँखें टेढ़ी करता है, तब इसे देवता मी नहीं मार सकते, बल्कि इसको काल की तरह सममा ये सब मोहित अर्थात्‌ मूर्च्छित दो जाते हैँ

verses.sloka: काले धर्मार्थकामान् यः सम्मन्त्र्य सचिवैः सह ।निषेवेतात्मवान् लोके न स व्यसनमाप्नुयात् ।। ६.६३.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: kāle dharmārthakāmān yaḥ sammantrya sacivaiḥ saha ।niṣevetātmavān loke na sa vyasanamāpnuyāt ।। 6.63.12 ।।

translations.english: "You are the foremost of the Rakshasas! After discussing with ministers, a king either by gifting or conciliation or dissension or resorting to all of them at the appropriate time takes resort to pursue virtue, wealth, or sensual pleasures at the right time, never meets with sorrow."
translations.hindi: दूसरे राक्षसा को तो बरदान का बल है, किन्तु यह महाबली कुम्भकर्ण तो| स्वभाव ही से तेजस्त्री है

verses.sloka: हितानुबन्धमालोच्य कार्याकार्यमिहात्मनः ।राजा सहार्थतत्त्वज्ञैः सचिवैः स हि जीवति ।। ६.६३.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: hitānubandhamālocya kāryākāryamihātmanaḥ ।rājā sahārthatattvajñaiḥ sacivaiḥ sa hi jīvati ।। 6.63.13 ।।

translations.english: "That king who knows the reality of things and makes decisions in consultation with his ministers, who make their living with their intelligence will live happily."
translations.hindi: “ “इक डे इस महाबलवान ने उत्पन्न होते ही भूख से विकल हो, बहुत से हजारों जोर्वो को खा डाला था

verses.sloka: अनभिज्ञाय शास्त्रार्थान् पुरुषाः पशुबुद्धयः ।प्रागल्भ्याद्वक्तुमिच्छन्ति मन्त्रेष्वभ्यन्तरीकृताः ।। ६.६३.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: anabhijñāya śāstrārthān puruṣāḥ paśubuddhayaḥ ।prāgalbhyādvaktumicchanti mantreṣvabhyantarīkṛtāḥ ।। 6.63.14 ।।

translations.english: "People whose intelligence level is no better than animals, who have been included to express their views, who do not know the meaning of shastras express their views out of impudence."
translations.hindi: उसके इस प्रजाभन्षण कृत्य से प्रजा बहुत डरी और विकल हुई । फिर वह इन्द्र के पास गई ओर सारा वृत्तान्त उनसे कहा

verses.sloka: अशास्त्रविदुषां तेषां न कार्यमहितं वचः ।अर्थशास्त्रानभिज्ञानां विपुलां श्रियमिच्छताम् ।। ६.६३.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: aśāstraviduṣāṁ teṣāṁ na kāryamahitaṁ vacaḥ ।arthaśāstrānabhijñānāṁ vipulāṁ śriyamicchatām ।। 6.63.15 ।।

translations.english: "Those who have no knowledge of shastras are ignorant of the science of wealth and desire huge wealth. Their advice ought not to be followed."
translations.hindi: तब वञ्जधारी इन्द्र ने कुपित हो अपना पैना वज्र कुम्भकर्ण पर चलाया | यई बलवान वज्त्र लगने पर कुछ विचलित तो हुआ किन्तु क्रोध में भर बड़े जोर से गर्जा

verses.sloka: अहितं च हिताकारं धार्ष्ट्याज्जल्पन्ति ये नराः ।अवेक्ष्य मन्त्रबाह्यास्ते कर्तव्याः कृत्यदूषणाः ।। ६.६३.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ahitaṁ ca hitākāraṁ dhārṣṭyājjalpanti ye narāḥ ।avekṣya mantrabāhyāste kartavyāḥ kṛtyadūṣaṇāḥ ।। 6.63.16 ।।

translations.english: "Those who tender advice, which is unwholesome but in wholesome grab, out of their impudence should be kept away from discussion examining early as they mar the purpose."
translations.hindi: तब बुद्धिमान कुम्भकर्ण के गजेने से और उसे सन और भी अधिक भयभीत हुई

verses.sloka: विनाशयन्तो भर्तारं सहिताः शत्रुभिर्बुधैः ।विपरीतानि कृत्यानि कारयन्तीह मन्त्रिणः ।। ६.६३.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: vināśayanto bhartāraṁ sahitāḥ śatrubhirbudhaiḥ ।viparītāni kṛtyāni kārayantīha mantriṇaḥ ।। 6.63.17 ।।

translations.english: "Some ministers in order to ruin the king, collide with enemies and make the king take wrong actions."
translations.hindi: उधर महाबली कुम्भकण ने कुपित हो इन ह! इन्द्र के ऐरावत हाथी का दात उखाड़, इन्द्र ही की छाती में मारा

verses.sloka: तान् भर्ता मित्रसङ्काशानमित्रान् मन्त्रनिर्णये ।व्यवहारेण जानीयात् सचिवानुपसंहितान् ।। ६.६३.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tān bhartā mitrasaṅkāśānamitrān mantranirṇaye ।vyavahāreṇa jānīyāt sacivānupasaṁhitān ।। 6.63.18 ।।

translations.english: " A ruler should know those ministers bribed by the enemy, who have become close to the enemy and appear as friends. Those ministers must be known through their behaviour in the deliberations."
translations.hindi: ॥ कुम्भकर्ण के प्रहार से पीड़ित हो इन्द्र अत्यन्त कृपित हुए। न्द्र को घायल दे कर अन्य देवता, ब्रह्मषि और दानव सब बहुत दु:खी हुए

verses.sloka: चपलस्येह कृत्यानि सहसानुप्रधावतः ।छिद्रमन्ये प्रपद्यन्ते क्रौञ्चस्य स्वमिव द्विजाः ।। ६.६३.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: capalasyeha kṛtyāni sahasānupradhāvataḥ ।chidramanye prapadyante krauñcasya svamiva dvijāḥ ।। 6.63.19 ।।

translations.english: "Enemies find out the weakness of the king who is unsteady and rush after the actions forcibly without thinking like brahmins just as birds find the holes in Krauncha mountain and elaborate to others."

verses.sloka: यो हि शत्रुमविज्ञाय नात्मानमभिरक्षति ।अवाप्नोति हि सो ऽनर्थान् स्थानाच्च व्यवरोप्यते ।। ६.६३.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: yo hi śatrumavijñāya nātmānamabhirakṣati ।avāpnoti hi so 'narthān sthānācca vyavaropyate ।। 6.63.20 ।।

translations.english: "He who knowing fully the actions of the enemy does not protect himself he attains reverses and is also dragged down from position."
translations.hindi: कम्भकर्ण द्वारा प्रजाओं का भक्षण किया जाना, देवताओं का सपाया जाना, तपस्वियों के आश्रमों का उजाडा जाना और परखी-हरण आदि कुस्भकणं की समस्त दुष्टताए कहीं

verses.sloka: यदुक्तमिह ते पूर्वं क्रियतामनुजेन च ।तदेव नो हितं कार्यं यदिच्छसि च तत् कुरु ।। ६.६३.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: yaduktamiha te pūrvaṁ kriyatāmanujena ca ।tadeva no hitaṁ kāryaṁ yadicchasi ca tat kuru ।। 6.63.21 ।।

translations.english: "The advice given to you in the past by your brother alone is good. That is good for you. Or you may do what you wish."
translations.hindi: और अन्त में यह भी कहा कि, यदि वह इसी तरह नित्य प्रजां का भक्षण करता रहा तो थोड़े ही दिनों में संसार सूना हो जायगा

verses.sloka: तत्तु श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः कुम्भकर्णस्य भाषितम् ।भ्रुकुटिं चैव सञ्चक्रे क्रुद्धश्चैनमभाषत ।। ६.६३.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tattu śrutvā daśagrīvaḥ kumbhakarṇasya bhāṣitam ।bhrukuṭiṁ caiva sañcakre kruddhaścainamabhāṣata ।। 6.63.22 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna having spoken that way, the ten headed Ravana frowned, shaking his eyebrows in anger and spoke this way.

verses.sloka: मान्यो गुरुरिवाचार्यः किं मां त्वमनुशाससि ।किमेवं वाक्छ्रमं कृत्वा युक्तं विधीयताम् ।। ६.६३.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: mānyo gururivācāryaḥ kiṁ māṁ tvamanuśāsasi ।kimevaṁ vākchramaṁ kṛtvā yuktaṁ vidhīyatām ।। 6.63.23 ।।

translations.english: "Why do you, who are worthy of respect, instruct me like a father or teacher? These words express your cleverness in speaking. It is time to do what is appropriate now. Follow what is to be done."
translations.hindi: कम्भकर्ण को देखा ब्रह्मा बाबा भी डर गए । फिर कुम्भकण को देख और उसे लुभा कर ब्रह्मा जी ने उससे यह कहा

verses.sloka: विभ्रमाच्चित्तमोहाद्वा बलवीर्याश्रयेण वा ।नाभिपन्नमिदानीं यद्व्यर्थास्तस्य पुनः कथाः ।। ६.६३.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: vibhramāccittamohādvā balavīryāśrayeṇa vā ।nābhipannamidānīṁ yadvyarthāstasya punaḥ kathāḥ ।। 6.63.24 ।।

translations.english: "Due to delusion, or lack of understanding or due to pride of my strength I did something. To talk of it now again is futile."
translations.hindi: हे इम्भकण्‌ ! निश्चय ही संसार का नाश करने के लिए ही विश्रवा मुनि ने तुझे उत्पन्न किया हे । अतएव आज से झुदें की तरह पड़ा सोया करेगा

verses.sloka: अस्मिन् काले तु यद्युक्तं तदिदानीं विधीयताम् ।गतं तु नानुशोचन्ति गतं तु गतमेव हि ।। ६.६३.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: asmin kāle tu yadyuktaṁ tadidānīṁ vidhīyatām ।gataṁ tu nānuśocanti gataṁ tu gatameva hi ।। 6.63.25 ।।

translations.english: "You may speak of only what is proper to do now. Do not think of the past as it is gone."

verses.sloka: ममापनयजं दोषं विक्रमेण समीकुरु ।यदि खल्वस्ति मे स्नेहो विक्रमं वा ऽवगच्छसि ।यदि वा कार्यमेतत्ते हृदि कार्यतमं मतम् ।। ६.६३.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: mamāpanayajaṁ doṣaṁ vikrameṇa samīkuru ।yadi khalvasti me sneho vikramaṁ vā 'vagacchasi ।yadi vā kāryametatte hṛdi kāryatamaṁ matam ।। 6.63.26 ।।

translations.english: "If at all there is any affection in you for me now, you recognize your strengths and think what action is justified in your heart. You may nullify the evil that sprung from my heart."
translations.hindi: हे प्रजापते ! यह चम्पा का वृक्ष बढ़ कर जब फूलने योग्य हुआ, तब आप इसे काटे डालते हैँ। महाराज यह तो आप ही का पोत्र है । इसको इस प्रकार शाप देना उचित|नहीं

verses.sloka: स सुहृद् यो विपन्नार्थं दीनमभ्यवपद्यते ।स बन्धुर्यो ऽपनीतेषु साहाय्यायोपकल्पते ।। ६.६३.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa suhṛd yo vipannārthaṁ dīnamabhyavapadyate ।sa bandhuryo 'panīteṣu sāhāyyāyopakalpate ।। 6.63.27 ।।

translations.english: " A friend is one who helps when one's fortune is lost and is desperate. Deviating from morals the one who is prepared to help is a relation."
translations.hindi: आपका वचन तो कभी मिथ्या हो नहीं सकता और निःसं- शाय यह उसी प्रकार सोवेगा भी । किन्तु श्राप इसके सोने और जागने का समय ही नियत कर दें

verses.sloka: तमथैवं ब्रुवाणं तु वचनं धीरदारुणम् ।रुष्टो ऽयमिति विज्ञाय शनैः श्लक्ष्णमुवाच ह ।। ६.६३.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamathaivaṁ bruvāṇaṁ tu vacanaṁ dhīradāruṇam ।ruṣṭo 'yamiti vijñāya śanaiḥ ślakṣṇamuvāca ha ।। 6.63.28 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter knowing that Ravana is agitated and arguing in a grave and harsh manner, Kumbhakarna, spoke slowly in a gentle tone.
translations.hindi: रावण के इन बचनों को सुन, ब्रा जी बोले-यह छः मास सोवेगा और एक दिन जागेगा

verses.sloka: अतीव हि समालक्ष्य भ्रातरं क्षुभितेन्द्रियम् ।कुम्भकर्णः शनैर्वाक्यं बभाषे परिसान्त्वयन् ।। ६.६३.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: atīva hi samālakṣya bhrātaraṁ kṣubhitendriyam ।kumbhakarṇaḥ śanairvākyaṁ babhāṣe parisāntvayan ।। 6.63.29 ।।

translations.english: Sensing that Ravana is disturbed very much, Kumbhakarna taking hold of the brother and consoling him slowly said these words.

verses.sloka: अलं राक्षसराजेन्द्र सन्तापमुपपद्य ते ।रोषं च सम्परित्यज्य स्वस्थो भवितुमर्हसि ।। ६.६३.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: alaṁ rākṣasarājendra santāpamupapadya te ।roṣaṁ ca samparityajya svastho bhavitumarhasi ।। 6.63.30 ।।

translations.english: "Listen to my words, Rakshasa king! You are a scourge of enemies. Put aside this sorrow. Give up the agony also. Be normal. You ought to be your normal self again."
translations.hindi: है श्रीरामचन्द्र ! तुम्हारे पराक्रम से भीत हो और विपत्ति में पड, रादसराज रावण ने इस समय इस कुम्भकण को जग- वायाहे

verses.sloka: नैतन्मनसि कर्तव्यं मयि जीवति पार्थिव ।तमहं नाशयिष्यामि यत्कृते परितप्यसे ।। ६.६३.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: naitanmanasi kartavyaṁ mayi jīvati pārthiva ।tamahaṁ nāśayiṣyāmi yatkṛte paritapyase ।। 6.63.31 ।।

translations.english: "Listen to my words, Rakshasa king! You are a scourge of enemies. Put aside this sorrow. Give up the agony also. Be normal. You ought to be your normal self again."
translations.hindi: स एप निगेतो बीरः १शिबिराद्भीमबिक्रमः । नन्‌ मशु गवस परिया ॥ २६ १ भक्तयनपरिधावति--भक्षणदेतोः परिधाविष्यति | (गो० ) २ शिबिरात्‌-स्वनिलयातू । ( गो० ) rar सो यह भीम पराक्रमी बीर अपने घर से निकल और अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध हो वानरों को खाने के लिए दोड़ेगा

verses.sloka: अवश्यं तु हितं वाच्यं सर्वावस्थं मया तव ।बन्धुभावादभिहितं भ्रातृस्नेहाच्च पार्थिव ।। ६.६३.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: avaśyaṁ tu hitaṁ vācyaṁ sarvāvasthaṁ mayā tava ।bandhubhāvādabhihitaṁ bhrātṛsnehācca pārthiva ।। 6.63.32 ।।

translations.english: "While I am (my body is) with life you need not entertain despondency. I will exterminate him, by whose account you are agitated."
translations.hindi: जब ये वानर कुम्भकर्ण को देखते ही भाग रहे हैं, जब यह क्रुद्ध हो समरेत्र में आ कर खड़ा होगा, तव वानर इसको कैसे रॉकेंगे ?

verses.sloka: सदृशं यत्तु काले ऽस्मिन् कर्तुं स्निग्धेन बन्धुना ।शत्रूणां कदनं पश्य क्रियमाणं मया रणे ।। ६.६३.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sadṛśaṁ yattu kāle 'smin kartuṁ snigdhena bandhunā ।śatrūṇāṁ kadanaṁ paśya kriyamāṇaṁ mayā raṇe ।। 6.63.33 ।।

translations.english: "O king! I will give you good advice in all circumstances being a relation. Salutary advice has been given to you out of brotherly affection."

verses.sloka: अद्य पश्य महाबाहो मया समरमूर्धनि ।हते रामे सह भ्रात्रा द्रवन्तीं परवाहिनीम् ।। ६.६३.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya paśya mahābāho mayā samaramūrdhani ।hate rāme saha bhrātrā dravantīṁ paravāhinīm ।। 6.63.34 ।।

translations.english: " At this time, you will see a relation doing that which is right out of affection. All enemies will be destroyed."
translations.hindi: मेरी समझ में वानरों को रोकने के लिए उनसे यह कह देना ठीक होगा कि, यह एक बड़ा ऊँचा वानरों के डराने के लिए होआ है | इसको यंत्र जान सब वानर निर्भय हो जाये विभीषशत्रचः श्र त्वा हेतुमत्सुमुखेरितम्‌२ । उवाच राघवो वाक्यं नीलं सेनापतिं तदा

verses.sloka: अद्य रामस्य तद् दृष्ट्वा मया ऽ ऽनीतं रणाच्छिरः ।सुखी भव महाबाहो सीता भवतु दुःखिता ।। ६.६३.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya rāmasya tad dṛṣṭvā mayā ' 'nītaṁ raṇācchiraḥ ।sukhī bhava mahābāho sītā bhavatu duḥkhitā ।। 6.63.35 ।।

translations.english: "O mighty armed King! You see Rama along with his brother being killed by me and Vanaras fleeing away from the forefront of war."

verses.sloka: अद्य रामस्य पश्यन्तु निधनं सुमहत् प्रियम् ।लङ्कायां राक्षसाः सर्वे ये ते निहतबान्धवाः ।। ६.६३.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya rāmasya paśyantu nidhanaṁ sumahat priyam ।laṅkāyāṁ rākṣasāḥ sarve ye te nihatabāndhavāḥ ।। 6.63.36 ।।

translations.english: "Be happy today, O Mighty armed brother! I will bring Rama's head from the battlefield. Sita will be sad. You will see."
translations.hindi: सब वानर शैलशज्ञों, वृ्षो, शिलाओं को एकत्र कर लें और द्वार्थो में हि दाएँ आयुधों को ले तैयार खड़े हो जाय

verses.sloka: अद्य शोकपरीतानां स्वबन्धुवधकारणात् ।शत्रोर्युधि विनाशेन करोम्यास्रप्रमार्जनम् ।। ६.६३.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya śokaparītānāṁ svabandhuvadhakāraṇāt ।śatroryudhi vināśena karomyāsrapramārjanam ।। 6.63.37 ।।

translations.english: " All the Rakshasas in Lanka whose relations have been killed will witness Rama's death which will be very welcome."

verses.sloka: अद्य पर्वतसङ्काशं ससूर्यमिव तोयदम् ।विकीर्णं पश्य समरे सुग्रीवं प्लवगोत्तमम् ।। ६.६३.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya parvatasaṅkāśaṁ sasūryamiva toyadam ।vikīrṇaṁ paśya samare sugrīvaṁ plavagottamam ।। 6.63.38 ।।

translations.english: Now I will wipe the tears of Rakshasas who lost their kin and are bewailing their loss.

verses.sloka: कथं त्वं राक्षसैरेभिर्मया च परिरक्षितः ।जिघांसुभिर्दाशरथिं वध्यसे त्वमिहानघ ।। ६.६३.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ tvaṁ rākṣasairebhirmayā ca parirakṣitaḥ ।jighāṁsubhirdāśarathiṁ vadhyase tvamihānagha ।। 6.63.39 ।।

translations.english: "Now you will see Sugriva the foremost of monkeys in mountain shape, resembling mountains bathed in blood like evening Sun illumined like the cloud."

verses.sloka: अथ पूर्वं हते तेन मयि त्वां हन्ति राघवः ।नाहमात्मनि सन्तापं गच्छेयं राक्षसाधिप ।। ६.६३.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: atha pūrvaṁ hate tena mayi tvāṁ hanti rāghavaḥ ।nāhamātmani santāpaṁ gaccheyaṁ rākṣasādhipa ।। 6.63.40 ।।

translations.english: "O Sinless Ravana! As I am going to kill this son of Dasaratha whom Rakshasas are intending to kill, how can Rama kill you now?"
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार बिजयी बानरगण, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के मुख से यह बात निकलते दी वृर्षो से, शर की उस सना शिका नगर की रक्षा के लिए नगर के बाहिर नियुक्त थी, मारन लगे ।।३६ ततो हरीणां तदनीकमुग्र रराज शैसोद्यतदीप्तहस्तम्‌ । २ परवाहिनीम--तगररक्ार्थ वहिश्चरन्ती वाहिनीं । ( Se वाहिनी (गो) बा० रा० यु०--४० गिरे! समीपानुगतं यथै महन्‌ महाम्भोधरजालमुग्रम्‌

verses.sloka: कामं त्विदानीमपि मां व्यादिश त्वं परन्तप ।न परः प्रेषणीयस्ते युद्धायातुलविक्रम ।। ६.६३.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: kāmaṁ tvidānīmapi māṁ vyādiśa tvaṁ parantapa ।na paraḥ preṣaṇīyaste yuddhāyātulavikrama ।। 6.63.41 ।।

translations.english: "Rakshasa king! Raghava will kill you only after killing me. Never give way for distress."

verses.sloka: अहमुत्सादयिष्यामि शत्रूंस्तव महाबल ।। ६.६३.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: ahamutsādayiṣyāmi śatrūṁstava mahābala ।। 6.63.42 ।।

translations.english: "Command me to wage war at this moment, O Scorcher of enemies. There is no one better than me to be sought for O hero endowed with extraordinary strength."

verses.sloka: यदि शक्रो यदि यमो यदि पावकमारुतौ ।तानहं योधयिष्यामि कुबेरवरुणावपि ।। ६.६३.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadi śakro yadi yamo yadi pāvakamārutau ।tānahaṁ yodhayiṣyāmi kuberavaruṇāvapi ।। 6.63.43 ।।

translations.english: "I shall exterminate your enemies, however mighty they may be. I can contend with Indra or fire god or Yama or wind god, Kubera or even Varuna."

verses.sloka: गिरिमात्रशरीरस्य शितशूलधरस्य मे ।नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रस्य बिभीयाच्च पुरन्दरः ।। ६.६३.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: girimātraśarīrasya śitaśūladharasya me ।nardatastīkṣṇadaṁṣṭrasya bibhīyācca purandaraḥ ।। 6.63.44 ।।

translations.english: "Even Indra with a body as big as a mountain, with pointed teeth like a spike, with sharp teeth will fear me and run if I roar.

verses.sloka: अथवा त्यक्तशस्त्रस्य मृद्नतस्तरसा रिपून् ।न मे प्रतिमुखे स्थातुं कश्चिच्छक्तो जिजीविषुः ।। ६.६३.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: athavā tyaktaśastrasya mṛdnatastarasā ripūn ।na me pratimukhe sthātuṁ kaścicchakto jijīviṣuḥ ।। 6.63.45 ।।

translations.english: "Or else giving up weapons and swords using my arms indeed I can crush, and no one can stand in front of me."

verses.sloka: नैव शक्त्या न गदया नासिना निशितैः शरैः ।हस्ताभ्यामेव संरब्धो हनिष्याम्यपि वज्रिणम् ।। ६.६३.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: naiva śaktyā na gadayā nāsinā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।hastābhyāmeva saṁrabdho haniṣyāmyapi vajriṇam ।। 6.63.46 ।।

translations.english: "I shall not fight with javelin or mace or sword or sharp arrows. Enraged, alone I can strike down even Indra."

verses.sloka: यदि मे मुष्टिवेगं स राघवो ऽद्य सहिष्यते ।ततः पास्यन्ति बाणौघा रुधिरं राघवस्य तु ।। ६.६३.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadi me muṣṭivegaṁ sa rāghavo 'dya sahiṣyate ।tataḥ pāsyanti bāṇaughā rudhiraṁ rāghavasya tu ।। 6.63.47 ।।

translations.english: "Now if that Raghava can withstand the force of my fists, you will see volleys of Rama's arrows will drink my blood."

verses.sloka: चिन्तया बाध्यसे राजन् किमर्थं मयि तिष्ठति ।सो ऽहं शत्रुविनाशाय तव निर्यातुमुद्यतः ।। ६.६३.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: cintayā bādhyase rājan kimarthaṁ mayi tiṣṭhati ।so 'haṁ śatruvināśāya tava niryātumudyataḥ ।। 6.63.48 ।।

translations.english: "O King! while I am here for what reason do you worry and have anxiety? I will go now and decidedly destroy your enemy."

verses.sloka: मुञ्च रामाद्भयं राजन् हनिष्यामीह संयुगे ।राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं च महाबलम् ।हनुमन्तं च रक्षोघ्नं लङ्का येन प्रदीपिता ।। ६.६३.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: muñca rāmādbhayaṁ rājan haniṣyāmīha saṁyuge ।rāghavaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ caiva sugrīvaṁ ca mahābalam ।hanumantaṁ ca rakṣoghnaṁ laṅkā yena pradīpitā ।। 6.63.49 ।।

translations.english: "O King! Give up the fear, as both Rama and Lakshmana will be made short of work in the battlefield, as also mighty Sugriva and dispose of Hanuman, the destroyer of many Rakshasas and who set fire to Lanka."

verses.sloka: हरींश्चापि हनिष्यामि संयुगे समवस्थितान् ।असाधारणमिच्छामि तव दातुं महद्यशः ।। ६.६३.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: harīṁścāpi haniṣyāmi saṁyuge samavasthitān ।asādhāraṇamicchāmi tava dātuṁ mahadyaśaḥ ।। 6.63.50 ।।

translations.english: "O King! Give up the fear, as both Rama and Lakshmana will be made short of work in the battlefield, as also mighty Sugriva and dispose of Hanuman, the destroyer of many Rakshasas and who set fire to Lanka."

verses.sloka: यदि चेन्द्राद्भयं राजन् यदि वापि स्वयम्भुवः ।। ६.६३.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadi cendrādbhayaṁ rājan yadi vāpi svayambhuvaḥ ।। 6.63.51 ।।

translations.english: "I will remain steady in the battlefield and devour monkeys also. I wish to confer an unusual and great glory on you."

verses.sloka: अपि देवाः शयिष्यन्ते क्रुद्धे मयि महीतले ।यमं च शमयिष्यामि भक्षयिष्यामि पावकम् ।आदित्यं पातयिष्यामि सनक्षत्रं महीतले ।। ६.६३.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: api devāḥ śayiṣyante kruddhe mayi mahītale ।yamaṁ ca śamayiṣyāmi bhakṣayiṣyāmi pāvakam ।ādityaṁ pātayiṣyāmi sanakṣatraṁ mahītale ।। 6.63.52 ।।

translations.english: "Even if there is fear of Indra and Brahma that haunts you, I shall destroy them away like the sun dispels darkness. Devas will fall flat on earth when I am enraged."

verses.sloka: शतक्रतुं वधिष्यामि पास्यामि वरुणालयम् ।पर्वतांश्चूर्णयिष्यामि दारयिष्यामि मेदिनीम् ।। ६.६३.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: śatakratuṁ vadhiṣyāmi pāsyāmi varuṇālayam ।parvatāṁścūrṇayiṣyāmi dārayiṣyāmi medinīm ।। 6.63.53 ।।

translations.english: "I shall quell Lord Yama also, devour fire god, make the Sun including stars fall on earth."

verses.sloka: दीर्घकालं प्रसुप्तस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य विक्रमम् ।अद्य पश्यन्तु भूतानि भक्ष्यमाणानि सर्वशः ।। ६.६३.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: dīrghakālaṁ prasuptasya kumbhakarṇasya vikramam ।adya paśyantu bhūtāni bhakṣyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ ।। 6.63.54 ।।

translations.english: "I shall kill Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, drink up the ocean the abode of Varuna, crush the mountains totally, and break the earth."

verses.sloka: नन्विदं त्रिदिवं सर्वमाहारस्य न पूर्यते ।। ६.६३.५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: nanvidaṁ tridivaṁ sarvamāhārasya na pūryate ।। 6.63.55 ।।

translations.english: " All beings all over will be eaten now. For a long time Kumbhakarna was sleeping. Now you will see that the food of all the three worlds, earth, heaven and intermediate region will not be enough to fill my stomach."

verses.sloka: वधेन ते दाशरथेः सुखार्हं सुखं समाहर्तुमहं व्रजामि ।निहत्य रामं सह लक्ष्मणेन खादामि सर्वान् हरियूथमुख्यान् ।। ६.६३.५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: vadhena te dāśaratheḥ sukhārhaṁ sukhaṁ samāhartumahaṁ vrajāmi ।nihatya rāmaṁ saha lakṣmaṇena khādāmi sarvān hariyūthamukhyān ।। 6.63.56 ।।

translations.english: " All beings all over will be eaten now. For a long time Kumbhakarna was sleeping. Now you will see that the food of all the three worlds, earth, heaven and intermediate region will not be enough to fill my stomach."

verses.sloka: रमस्व कामं पिब चाग्र्यवारुणीं कुरुष्व कृत्यानि विनीयतां ज्वरः ।मया ऽद्य रामे गमिते यमक्षयं चिराय सीता वशगा भविष्यति ।। ६.६३.५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ramasva kāmaṁ piba cāgryavāruṇīṁ kuruṣva kṛtyāni vinīyatāṁ jvaraḥ ।mayā 'dya rāme gamite yamakṣayaṁ cirāya sītā vaśagā bhaviṣyati ।। 6.63.57 ।।

translations.english: "Through the destruction of Rama, I will bring happiness to you who are worthy of happiness. I will collect Rama along with Lakshmana and all the Vanara leaders and devour all."

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। ६३ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe triṣaṣṭitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 63 ।।

translations.english: "Take your pleasure, O king, and drink the wine today; put away sorrow and attend to your affairs. When Rama has been sent by me to the abode of Yama, Sita shall long be submissive to you."
